gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.rationale: The presence of a KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation in the affected tissue supports the diagnosis of Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) Mutation-associated Vascular Lesion, which is further strengthened by the histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels.

rejected.label: Cherry Angioma
rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathological features and presence of a somatic mutation points away from this diagnosis

rejected.label: Telangiectasia
rejected.why: While telangiectasias are present, the diagnosis of Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) Mutation-associated Vascular Lesion better explains the findings

rejected.label: Cutaneous Angiokeratoma
rejected.why: The clinical and histological features do not align closely with this diagnosis
